Gnosis.$comment: USD + WETH for Gnosis. WETH bridges natively (canonical GC WETH 0x6A02…). USDC uses the USDCTransmuter (0x0392a2f5…) so the adapter lands the escrow-registered USDC.e (0x2a22f9c3): the OmniBridge delivers the legacy 'USD//C on xDai' (0xDDAfbb50), and the adapter swaps it 1:1 to USDC.e inbound (transmuter deposit) / USDC.e->legacy outbound (transmuter withdraw). Requires the salt-5 GnosisBridgeAdapter (transmuter-swap); `usdcTransmuter` is set ONLY on this chain (Gnosis) — the Ethereum-side adapter leaves it address(0) and bridges native USDC. Stargate remains available for USD<->Gnosis too; the operator chooses per transfer.

CCIP.$comment: Disabled on Gnosis: CCIP has no token pool for the registered assets (USDC/WETH) on this chain, so the router reverts UnsupportedToken. Bridge Gnosis via Stargate for USD (delivers USDC.e) and the native omnibridge for WETH.
